note: BOOK BACK MATTER, NOT CHAPTER 14 CONTENT. This is printed page 523, the fourth page of the book's INDEX (the chapter-14 PDF runs on past the chapter's real end into the book's back matter: answers, bibliography, index). An index is publishing furniture and MUST NOT be used as chapter-14 passage text, and no index line may be treated as chapter prose. It is transcribed only because the A2 schema rejects a zero-block page and so the page-coverage check can see the page was deliberately accounted for rather than dropped. previous_page_last_block was null, so continuation was judged from the existing p054 output, whose index run ended at 'Nuclear / winter 457'; this page resumes the same alphabetical list at 'Numerical aperture', and for an alphabetical index a column running past the page foot counts as a continuation, so first_block_continues_from_previous is true. Two columns, left first, which is also the order the text layer uses: block n=1 is the left column (Numerical aperture 375 ... Quantisation of charge 8) and block n=2 the right column (Radio waves 281 ... Thermionic emission 388). Copied exactly as the text layer spells it, including the double spaces in 'energy for a system  of charges', 'energy of a system of  two charges' and 'Right  hand rule', the multi-reference entries ('11, 76', '71, 376', '317, 356', '96, 468', '310, 311'), and the entry 'Primary coil', which is printed with no page reference at all on this page. The page banner 'Index', the page number 523 and the reprint year 2022-23 are furniture and are listed as removed. The index runs on to the next page (the T entries are unfinished), so the last block is marked continues_on_next. No equations, tables or figures on this page.
